study type: Before-and-after study with retrospective (pre-intervention) and prospective (post-intervention) components
exposure: Implementation of a multidisciplinary obstetric and hematology care team
cohort: The participants were 158 pregnant women with Sickle Cell Disease (SCD) in the pre-intervention period and 90 in the post-intervention period at the Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital.
finding: Implementing a multidisciplinary obstetric and hematology team approach dramatically reduced maternal mortality by 89.1% and decreased perinatal mortality by 62.2% in women with SCD in a low-resource setting.
